author: /root/review_bead_rs
scope: Fixed owned interruption markers and original native metadata; no SQL, native command, process creation, write, rename or database copy.
checks: Only ordinary fixed parents and files are read; path and file signatures are rechecked.
Native database files, sidecars, locks and large snapshots receive metadata checks only.
Raw small files are preserved with exact base64 and SHA-256; omitted content is explicit.
BelowNormal and existing resource guards remain active. Root holds the serialized writer window.
